notes: Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS (product telemetry + NPS insights). Started with Hosted POC in Aug — quick onboarding, SDK integration went smoothly. Host API used for prototype chat assistant and reranker; saw good quality but token costs at projected QPS look high. After spike test (10k MAU simulation) they asked about Dedicated to control costs and guarantee throughput. AE demo 2024-09-21: showed hosted performance, streaming. SE-led benchmarking 10/02: 95th pctl latency for chat ~110ms on hosted; embeddings QPS ok. Team is risk-averse on noisy neighbors; wants isolated GPU pools + certs. Procurement loop started Oct; legal returned MSA redlines 10/25 (major asks: liability cap increase, narrower data use clause, DPA changes for EU residency). Security asked for SOC2 Type II + recent pen-test results and clarity on KMS integration.

poe_and_poc_details: Hosted POC: 3-week, product chat + reranking, sample dataset 1.2M docs
Dedicated pilot ask: 14-day traffic-forward pilot with reserved GPU pool (mirror prod traffic ~50 rps)
Targets: 95th pctl chat latency <120ms, embedding latency <50ms for 768-d vectors, sustain 80-100 req/s per shard
Success metrics: cost/unit lower than hosted by 30% at projected scale; no p99 latency regressions; pass security checklist
procurement_and_legal_notes: Primary legal points: liability cap to 12 months revenue; carveouts for gross negligence; termination for convenience notice period reduced
DPA asks: explicit EU data residency option + subprocessor list and 30-day notification for changes
SLA negotiation: customer requests 99.95% across dedicated clusters, service credits tiered by outage duration
Vendor onboarding: 120-question security questionnaire, references, COI, signed DPA before PO
Finance requires a 2-year commit to unlock the proposed discount tiers; procurement pushing for pilot-first with PO contingent on results
sales_play_and_risks: Play: Convert PoC success to 2-year Dedicated contract with phased rollouts and canary routes; include escape hatches and trial credits
Upside: If Dedicated reduces token costs by target, ARR likely move to $120k-$180k band
Risks: Legal stall on indemnity + DPA; security may require additional controls (HSM/KMS integration effort); cost model gap if usage >> forecast
